reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Section 3.1 fees are a 30% share of actual Net Sales above an $11,000/month threshold (so nothing is payable absent sales), and Section 4.1 provides a one-year term with 90-day termination rather than a multi-year lock-in — no minimum, take-or-pay, shortfall or usage volume cap on the Company.

The rationale correctly parks adjacent issues elsewhere: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment is an exit fee (termination-fee rule) and Section 6.1 exclusivity is a non-compete, neither being a purchase commitment, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
Tone and formatting comply with the playbook (no unnecessary redline, no lecture), and no deterministic check failures were raised.
